messages.text:
- **Brass floor lamp:** I’m sorry, but the refund deadline was November 14, 2026. An earlier proposal rejected by staff does not preserve eligibility after the deadline, even if it was submitted on time, so a new request is now too late. (refund-policy/v2/window)
- **Linen drum lampshade:** Your order is marked as shipped, not delivered. Only delivered orders qualify for this refund process; cancellation or delivery changes are outside it. Would you like a staff member to help with the lampshade order? (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders)
